en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a European city square with historic buildings. On the left stands a tall clock tower attached to a baroque-style building; in the center of the square there are statues and a fountain surrounded by pedestrians, cars, and buses. The reverse side has Hungarian text, postage stamps, and the printed caption identifying the location.
